subject: general
question: Town A lies to the southwest of Town R. Town D lies to the east of Town A. Town T lies to the southeast of Town D. Town R lies to the north of Town T. Town M lies to the southeast of Town T. What is the position of Town M with respect to Town D?
solution:
Given:

Town A lies to the southwest of Town R.

Town D lies to the east of Town A.

Town T lies to the southeast of Town D.

Town R lies to the north of Town T.

Town M lies to the southeast of Town T. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a37f403a76d91ceaa002ba451d137fcc2004ed6c40ad097e3ff094bb4c666da.png] 

Thus, Town M lies to the southeast of Town D.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
